messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started to production cluster 'prod-us-west-2' by @sami
commit: 9fa3b2c tag: release/v2.4.1
Components: runtime, api-gateway, model-cache
Change window: 2026-03-20 22:00-23:00 UTC

sami: starting canary, will monitor metrics :eyes:

ci-bot: CI gate failed for release/v2.4.1
- integration-tests (backend) failed (10/10 flaky)
- e2e/payment-flow timed out
Logs: https://ci.company/12345
Action: auto-blocking deploy

laura: can someone paste the failing test logs? might be infra flake

jay: rerunning the failed stage now (rerun id 6789)

deploy-bot: Deploy blocked: CI gate failure. Holding canary; will not proceed until manual unblock.

sami: knew we had a noisy dependency. pausing rollout. what's ETA on rerun?

jay: rerun queued, but cluster showed high pod restarts earlier; doing a targeted retry.

ci-bot: Rerun finished: integration-tests still failing (5 new failures). Failing tests:
```
TestPaymentProcessing::test_retry_on_429
TestKVCache::test_concurrent_eviction
```
Possible root cause: redis connection resets.

morgan: redis cluster had alerts around that time. Ops looking into it.

laura: ops confirmed transient redis instability. we can't keep blocking prod deploy on infra flakiness during change window. Options:
1) pin to previous tag and abort this release
2) force-unblock now and monitor
3) delay to next change window

release-coordinator: change window ends in 25 minutes. If we don't unblock, we should either rollback or pin now.

sami: prefer pinning previous stable (release/v2.4.0) for safety. requeue v2.4.1 after infra stabilizes.

jay: I can roll back canary to v2.4.0 and schedule a patch. rolling canary back now.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated to release/v2.4.0 by @jay. Notifying monitoring.

ops-runbooks: note - open incident created for redis: INC-2026-102. Link: https://incidents/company/INC-2026-102

sami: thanks. tagging this in release notes: hold v2.4.1 due to CI flake likely caused by redis instability.

laura: I'll open a PR to pin canary tag and add a postmortem checklist / rollback playbook.

jay: deploy finished: canary rollback complete. status=success. metrics look stable.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: canary rollback applied. thread closed unless further action.
